claims.statement: The memory-export fragment describes reuse of existing exports for two hours, including another person's bulk request or an export for the same user, so results may lag current state; it also states a limit of ten exports per hour without specifying the rate-limit principal here. This is not a fresh export receipt, permission to collect personal data, or verified live limit.

The memory introduction describes the feature as public preview subject to change and presents codebase and personal-preference learning as helping agents work effectively. This is a source capability description, not proof of accurate learning, consent to retain personal information, or measured effectiveness; the linked concept page is not reviewed here.

The model-autoenablement fragment describes a policy for Business or Enterprise enterprises controlling the default treatment of unconfigured generally available models. It does not specify the chosen policy value, cover configured or preview models, or attest to current model access; the linked reference is not reviewed by this receipt.

The model-picker fragment requires organization permission to switch models for Business subscriptions. Its ghec condition adds Enterprise subscriptions, enterprise authority, and the enterprise-policy link; those additions are absent outside that branch. This conditional upstream requirement is not an actual permission grant or verified account setting.

The exclusion-log fragment describes expanding an entry and hovering a truncated excluded_paths value to inspect settings after a saved change. Historical recorded settings and screenshot captions do not prove present effective exclusions, complete audit retrieval, or native behavior; the image was not visually inspected.

The fragment lists repository Agents-tab navigation, the agents page reachable directly or through View all, and the top-right navigation icon for opening the panel. These are UI entry points, not session launch, delegated execution, paid authorization, or a live agent receipt.
